Payload.$Comment: Mob scaling is switched off entirely in this instance. The pattern core here is longer than the one in Dungeon of Fear I, which is why a world matching both lands on this rule: the longest literal core wins. Add "GameplayConfig": ["YourKey"] beside the pattern if your instance authors one - that axis outranks every name pattern and never changes when the instance is rebuilt. PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is pinned to 0 so that an owner who flips Enabled back on gets the player/group delta from the first block, instead of the global newcomer ring around world spawn suppressing it.
